Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. nsure compliance with all the applicable laws / acts / rules including but not limited to all Labour Laws such as The Minimum Wages Act, 1948, The Pay ment of Wages Act, 1936, The Payment of Bonus Act, 1965, The Equal Rem uneration Act, 1976, The Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972 etc. Any non-comp liance will be treated as breach of contract and Buyer may take suitable act ions as per GeM Contract Additional Terms and Conditions 1. Participating bidders should have 2–3 service centers in Andhra Pradesh. If the bidder does not submit proof that they have service centers in Andhra Pradesh, they will be disqualified. Participating bidders should have 2–3 service centres in Andhra Pradesh. If the bidder does not submit pro of that they have service centres in Andhra Pradesh, they will be disqualified. 2. Safe specifications Class 61 BB Class (Jewel Safe), TRTL-15x6. The dimensions and specifications shall be as per IS 550 (Part D):2014. 3. OEM experience The OEM should have a minimum experience of 5 years as on 28.02.2026 in the activity of supply of TRTL s afes. 4. Financial standing The OEM must have submitted its last three financial years’ financial statements for 2023–2024, 2024–202 5 and 2025-2026. 5. BIS marking The safe shall be marked with the IS 550 listing mark as per BIS Rules for TRTL 1.5×6 rating. The BIS labell ing should clearly indicate the manufacturer/brand name, class and rating of the product, year of manufac ture, IS No. and CM/L No. allotted by BIS. 6. Safe type Safes required will be Class BB 1340 Single Door as per IS 550 (Part I):2014. 7. Lock OEM and certification The vendor should have an OEM for locks, and IS 17566 certificates are required. 8. Authorized dealership Only authorized dealers of Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) are eligible. An authorization letter s hould be enclosed in the OEM’s letterhead. 9. Valid BIS licence The OEM shall have a valid BIS licence for all physical security equipment mentioned in the tender. If the B IS licence of the bidder for any applied-category product expires before completion of the process, a renew ed licence will have to be submitted to the Bank, failing which the bidder will be declared ineligible. 10. Minimum weight The safe weight should be at least 1,600 kg. 11. Random testing and replacement The OEM and/or Authorized Agent shall provide the Bank with written consent for random testing of the pro

duct supplied to the Bank, at their cost, at the current test laboratory approved by BIS, at any time. The O EM/Authorized Agent shall replace the product with a new product of the same class before sending it for t esting, free of all costs. The OEM/Authorized Agent shall also provide written consent to transport the prod uct to be tested from the branch to the testing venue and bear the testing charges payable to the testing a gency. The above requirements shall be at the Bank’s exclusive discretion, if and when required. 12. Relevant experience Experience with PSU banks/Scheduled Commercial Banks shall only be acceptable. A copy of the purchase order must be attached with the bid, along with the purchaser’s contact details for verification. 13. ISO certification ISO certification must be provided by the vendor. 14. Non-blacklisting declaration The OEM should not have been blacklisted/debarred during the last three years preceding submission of th e bid by any Government Department, Financial Institution, Public Sector Unit or Scheduled Commercial B ank in India. The OEM should submit a declaration on its company letterhead. 15. Empaneled vendors Only empaneled bidders of Bank of Baroda are required to participate in the Tender 16. Delivery Instructions L-1 Bidder/ Identified Bidder has to supply and install the safes at respective sites mentioned. Details of th e site details (various Branches covered in Andhrapradesh state, Bank of Baroda -Guntur Region) shall be shared in the work order seperately. 17. Site feasibility check Bidder has to verify and check the site feasibility before delivering the safe/s to the sites being specified. If any site being specified in the work order is not feasible to accommodate the safe, the same may be delive red to other site as instructed by the buyer without any additional cost. .
